plugins.name: day-trader-skills-nse
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for NSE day trading: a chart scanner, a quarterly-results monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager, a Kite order-ticket writer (you place the orders), price alerts, a results analyst and a bulk/block-deals tracker.
